reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as enhanced Cr diffusion and pre-oxidation are well-established methods to improve Cr2O3 passivation in stainless steels, though the exact heat treatment and its effect on bulk properties are not specified.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with well-defined measurements and a decisive falsification criterion based on surface analysis and electrochemical performance.
